In detail

The City of Kraków's own official resident-safety survey (end of 2022, published January 2023) found Mistrzejowice tied for the lowest share of residents able to name a specific "dangerous spot" in their district (1.9%, second only to Dębniki's 1%). It was also grouped with Bieńczyce and Wzgórza Krzesławickie in the 2022 police breakdown as one of the lowest-crime groupings citywide (just 1 sexual offence and 377 total thefts combined). Both signals point the same direction for this specific district. Sources checked: City of Kraków official resident-safety survey, krakow.pl (published January 2023); Portal Samorządowy (2022 police district data).
